verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ebram de vrẹn nẹ Ijipt, te ọye vẹ aye rọye, kugbe obo ro vwori ejobi, ọ vẹ Lọt usun, vwo kpo obi Nẹgẹb.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebram de vren ne ijipt te oye ve aye roye kugbe obo ro vwori ejobi o ve lot usun vwo kpo obi negeb

verses.text_urhobo: Asakiephana Ebram feri gangan vwẹ uchuru, idọnọ efuanfon kugbe oro.
verses.text_romanized: asakiephana ebram feri gangan vwe uchuru idono efuanfon kugbe oro

verses.text_urhobo: O de vrẹn nẹ Nẹgẹb ọ da yan rhiri re te Bẹtẹl, re te asan rọ bọn utughẹ rọye phihọ ẹsosuọ, uvwre ri Bẹtẹl vẹ Ai,
verses.text_romanized: o de vren ne negeb o da yan rhiri re te betel re te asan ro bon utughe roye phiho esosuo uvwre ri betel ve ai

verses.text_urhobo: re te asan rẹ Ebram ka so agbada phihọ ẹsosuọ na; Ebram de se odẹ rẹ Ọrovwohwo vwẹ Etiyin.
verses.text_romanized: re te asan re ebram ka so agbada phiho esosuo na ebram de se ode re orovwohwo vwe etiyin

verses.text_urhobo: Lọt, vẹ Ebram gba usun na, ji vwo igegede kugbe uchuru vẹ itughẹ,
verses.text_romanized: lot ve ebram gba usun na ji vwo igegede kugbe uchuru ve itughe

verses.text_urhobo: ọtiọye na otọ na gbe gba aye-en, kidie ayen vwo eyere buebu, ayen gbe sa dia kugbe-e,
verses.text_romanized: otioye na oto na gbe gba aye en kidie ayen vwo eyere buebu ayen gbe sa dia kugbe e

verses.text_urhobo: oseghe kọ rhe dia vwe uvwre rẹ isuigodẹ rẹ Ebram vẹ isuigodẹ ri Lọt. Ọke yena ihwo ri Kenan kugbe ihwo ri Pẹriz je otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: oseghe ko rhe dia vwe uvwre re isuigode re ebram ve isuigode ri lot oke yena ihwo ri kenan kugbe ihwo ri periz je oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Ebram da ta ki Lọt, E gbi jẹ oseghe dia uvwre wẹ vẹ ọmẹ-ẹ kugbe uvwre rẹ isuigodẹ wẹn vẹ emẹ-ẹ, kidie avwanre iniọvo.
verses.text_romanized: ebram da ta ki lot e gbi je oseghe dia uvwre we ve ome e kugbe uvwre re isuigode wen ve eme e kidie avwanre iniovo

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ dia otọ na ejobi ri obaro wẹ na-a? Hẹriẹ oma wẹn nu vwe. Wo de kpo obọrhe, ki mi kpo obọhwẹre, eye wo de kpo obọhwẹre, ki mi kpo obọrhe.
verses.text_romanized: o dia oto na ejobi ri obaro we na a herie oma wen nu vwe wo de kpo oborhe ki mi kpo obohwere eye wo de kpo obohwere ki mi kpo oborhe

verses.text_urhobo: Lọt da kpare opharo, ọ da mrẹ ushekpotọ ri Jọdan na rọ pha djidjiro wọnwọn kiri udju rẹ Ọrovwohwo, kiri otọ rẹ Ijipt vwẹ ọke re de kpo obi Zoar, kẹ enẹ ọ epha tavwe rẹ Ọrovwohwo ke rhe ghwọrọ Sodọm vi Gomora.
verses.text_romanized: lot da kpare opharo o da mre ushekpoto ri jodan na ro pha djidjiro wonwon kiri udju re orovwohwo kiri oto re ijipt vwe oke re de kpo obi zoar ke ene o epha tavwe re orovwohwo ke rhe ghworo sodom vi gomora

verses.text_urhobo: Lọt ke jẹ ushekpotọ ri Jọdan na kẹ oma rọye, Lọt de nene obọrhe, kọye ayen da hẹriẹ oma nẹ ohwohwo
verses.text_romanized: lot ke je ushekpoto ri jodan na ke oma roye lot de nene oborhe koye ayen da herie oma ne ohwohwo

verses.text_urhobo: Ebram da dia otọ ri Kenan, yi Lọt ra dia uherevie rẹ irere rẹ ushekpotọ na, o de mu erhọ kẹrẹ Sodọm.
verses.text_romanized: ebram da dia oto ri kenan yi lot ra dia uherevie re irere re ushekpoto na o de mu erho kere sodom

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke nana ihwo ri Sodọm na brare gangan, iruimwemwu ride na vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana ihwo ri sodom na brare gangan iruimwemwu ride na vwe obaro re orovwohwo

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo da ta kẹ Ebram, ri Lọt vwọ yanran nu nẹ, Kpare ẹro wẹn kpenu, vwẹ asan wọ epha na, ri wo ni obenu vẹ obotọ te obọrhe vẹ obọhwẹre,
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta ke ebram ri lot vwo yanran nu ne kpare ero wen kpenu vwe asan wo epha na ri wo ni obenu ve oboto te oborhe ve obohwere

verses.text_urhobo: kidie otọ na ejobi re wọ mrẹ na Me vwẹ ayen kẹ wẹ kugbe uvwiẹ wẹn bẹdẹ.
verses.text_romanized: kidie oto na ejobi re wo mre na me vwe ayen ke we kugbe uvwie wen bede

verses.text_urhobo: Mi ru uvwiẹ wẹn bu kiri ibiekpẹn rẹ otọ na, kọye ohwo de se kere ibiekpẹn rẹ otọ na, ko ji se kere uvwiẹ wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: mi ru uvwie wen bu kiri ibiekpen re oto na koye ohwo de se kere ibiekpen re oto na ko ji se kere uvwie wen

verses.text_urhobo: Vrẹn, yan nene ugrogro rẹ otọ na te ohẹhẹre rọye, kidie wẹn Me vwọ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: vren yan nene ugrogro re oto na te ohehere roye kidie wen me vwo ke

verses.text_urhobo: Ebram da ghwiẹ utughẹ rọye, ọ da rhe dia kẹrẹ ọhahe ri Mamre, rọ kẹrẹ Hebrọn, kẹ Etiyin ọ da so agbada kẹ Ọrovwohwo.
verses.text_romanized: ebram da ghwie utughe roye o da rhe dia kere ohahe ri mamre ro kere hebron ke etiyin o da so agbada ke orovwohwo
